title: Session-end loose decisions
description:
Decisions raised during the 2026-05-12 session that don't fit naturally inside any other epic. Each child is a discrete choice that needs an answer; none of them block normative spec work, but leaving them un-decided creates drift.

Children:
- Push timing for accumulated session commits
- Re-evaluation of ic5s.3 and ic5s.4 (Tier 3 override re-confirmation)
- Pre-existing unstaged WIP (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .beads/* files)
- @everyone vs alternative names before fig9.1 locks the choice in

Note: a fifth decision raised in the same session — the suppression model for broadcast mentions — is NOT a child of this epic because it's already tracked as Decision #5 inside jmap-chat-spec-fig9.1. That bead's resolution is the suppression decision; don't file a duplicate.
